name: x2
title: Rate matrix on doublets constructed from nucleotide rates

args.name: submodel
args.description: The nucleotide substitution model applied at both positions

description: Construct a doublet substitution model by applying the same nucleotide model at both positions. Each instantaneous substitution changes one nucleotide. Root frequencies are the products of the nucleotide root frequencies; stationary inputs produce stationary doublet models.
